children: Palm oil rises in Asian trading, supported by bargain-buying activities following recent price weakness, says David Ng, a trader at Kuala Lumpur-based Iceberg X. However, he doesn't expect the upward trend to persist, given the record stock level in Malaysia. Ng says crude palm oil will likely face resistance at 4,300 ringgit a ton and find support at 4,150 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for February delivery is 54 ringgit higher at 4,283 ringgit a ton. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
